heroHeadline: JNIM Seizes Diapaga — Last FAB Buffer Before Togo Border Falls; Manantali Power Grid Sabotaged; Djibo Evacuation Signals Ongoing JNIM Hold
heroSubtitle: In a 48-hour campaign, JNIM has overrun Diapaga (Est Region, Burkina Faso) on May 12–13 — the last major military buffer post before the Togolese border — killing 50+ soldiers and VDP and releasing prison inmates, while simultaneously sabotaging the Manantali hydroelectric transmission line feeding Bamako's power grid. The Djibo aftermath deepens: Ansaroul Islam's leadership network is publicly appealing for civilians to evacuate from military sites, signaling imminent follow-on strikes on the May 11 target. In Mali, the Ménaka urban standoff extends to Day 15, with FAMa relying solely on airstrikes while ISSP holds approaches and mortar lines on the former UN base. JNIM's multi-country simultaneous offensive arc — Diapaga, Djibo, Bamako grid, Ménaka corridor — confirms the insurgency's operational coordination across a 1,500 km front with no detectable degradation following three weeks of AES counter-operations.
